items.title: Record witnesses and their traces, depths 20 to 160
items.what: The best known white-run record at every depth 20..160 of the forced left side beside the alternating wall: 141 blocks, 104 at the exact value (every depth 20..120 and 132, 139, 142). Each block gives the depth, the run L, the phase, the horizon T, then the column-1 trace, the visible word, the forced left row at time 0 and the right half.
items.schema: Blocks "d=<depth> L=<run> phase=<0|1> T=<horizon> status=<exact|>=>" then four lines trace=, visible=, left=, right= as 0/1 strings; comment lines start with #.
items.source: rule30_local_record_traces.py (Local), from the RLK/CUT SAT runs; replays both ways with its check mode.

items.title: Sampled witnesses for lower bounds on the record (Local)
items.what: Right halves at time 0 that, with the forced left half, keep the alternating wall and show a white run of length L at depth d; lower bounds R_real(d) >= L at deep depths found by random sampling.
items.schema: Blocks "d=<depth> phase=<0|1> L=<run> T=<horizon> cells=<n> verified=yes" then the right half over sites 1..n as 0/1, wrapped at 100 characters.
items.replay: python3 tests/probes/lexicon/rule30_witness_check.py D L PHASE LEFT RIGHT   (see the file header)

items.title: Sampled witnesses for lower bounds on the record (Intel)
items.what: The same kind of witnesses as Local's file, found independently on a second machine.
items.source: Intel's copy of the sampling probe (2026-10-11).

items.title: Certified minimal forbidden visible words to length 44, both phases
items.what: Every word of length up to 44 that column 1, read at the white-wall ticks, can never produce beside the alternating wall, and that is minimal (both shorter factors occur): 1,130 words in phase 0 and 1,199 in phase 1, each proved absent by a SAT certificate checked by cake_lpr.
items.schema: Sections "## phase 0" and "## phase 1", one word per line; a header explains the phase convention.
items.source: rule30_sofic_test.py (the exact language by cone SAT) and rule30_mfw_certify.py (certificates), Local.

items.title: Record table with histograms and witness words (Local)
items.what: For each depth, the record white run, the histogram of runs over all seeds, and the witness words.
items.schema: Lines "R d L count", "H d L n" (histogram) and "W d <word>".

items.title: Independent replay of the records (Cloud)
items.what: Cloud's independent replay of the record values and the clock cores, as a check on Local's table.

items.title: Records by centre word
items.what: Record white runs when the centre is held to words other than 0101, with how many prefixes reach them.
items.schema: Lines "R <word> d = L (k of N prefixes reach it); cap C" and "H <word> d : run:count ...".

items.title: The ring census: Rule 30 on rings of every small size
items.what: For each ring size, the number of cycles, periodic states, the largest period, the longest transient and gliding cycles (travelling waves). The S ring (84 cells) and L ring (155 cells) are the waves column 1 can run in.
items.schema:
Lines "n cycles periodic

maxper single maxtransient gliding " with a lengths line.

items.title: The deep ladder
items.what: How many right halves keep the alternating wall for s steps at each width: the ladder R(m, s) that bounds how far from the centre a counterexample must sit.

items.title: Left-side horizons
items.what: For each seed width and seed, how far the left side keeps the clock.
items.schema: Lines "H w k = h  phase p  seed x".

items.title: Visible words of the collar's macro generators
items.what: The column-1 words of the typed macro chains beside the wall (S, L blocks), the objects the cut automaton reads.
items.schema: Blocks "name k-word ticks n" then n visible bits.

items.title: Minimal absent traces (Intel, strip form)
items.what: Minimal absent words of the strip relaxation of the visible language, the finite-width face of the exact language.

items.title: Forced-only words (Intel)
items.what: Words of the forced-only relaxation.

items.title: Channel bound counts
items.what: The exact counts behind the channel bound: how many column-1 words of each length occur beside the wall, in integer arithmetic.

items.title: The state of the proof
items.what: Where the three prize problems stand, every claim pointing to its section.

items.title: Period two: the open case in full
items.what: Every exact form of the problem, the closed routes, the status board.

items.title: The research record
items.what: The day-by-day record with its honest summary; section 8 is the work.

items.title: The record map
items.what: An index of the record by topic.

items.title: Collatz: the prize and the Rule 30 method
items.what: The Collatz twin: counting form, least-residue lemma, window principle.

items.what: The literature found, with what each result does and does not cover.

items.what: One line per experiment: what it tested, its predictions and its outcome; the scripts are beside it.
